snippet.title: Past Due: Midnight - Official Teaser
snippet.description:
Past Due: Midnight is a psychological first-person horror set in a twisted corporate office. An ordinary evening of overtime turns into a nightmare. You awaken at midnight, trapped in your office - but it’s no longer the place you recognize. Follow clues, solve puzzles, and interact with your surroundings - using whatever you can to push forward. As you progress, piece together the phantom story unfolding across the office’s abandoned floors. Can you survive the night and escape alive?
